verdict.rationale: Aircall's marketing describes built-in AI Assistants and AI Agents that take work off users: they capture notes, update CRM records, create follow-up tasks, give real-time suggestions, and handle after-hours or repetitive calls. The evidence shows a fixed set of automated tasks, not open-ended delegation where a user directs the assistant. The support is only homepage and pricing marketing copy. Missing for 10: user-directed ad-hoc task delegation to the assistant, in-depth first-party documentation of assistant capabilities and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records, and create follow-up tasks automatically
AI Assistants provide real-time guidance and suggested responses, improving performance in every conversation.
AI Agents handle after-hours calls, manage peak volume, and respond to repetitive requests automatically.
